notes: The bounded pass certifies the Web product action and its real native presentation, not global FLOW-NOTIFICATION-REPLY acceptance.

The real trial ran on 4a80fdc1. The later Product SHA 765fad3d changes only the reviewed capability-matrix fingerprint for the same service-worker blob, so the runtime trial was not repeated solely for that SHA.

Windows 11 and Chrome exposed one localized Reply action as the exact notification's VerbButton. A bounded SendInput click removed the notification but did not produce an observable notificationclick or Chat route on this host.

The failed-closed trial was resumed from its encrypted journals. Cleanup reported zero subscriptions, deliveries, profiles and journals; a separate read-only run audit confirmed zero Auth users, threads, messages and delivery logs.

Web has no native inline text-input notification API. When notificationclick is delivered, the existing worker routes this action to the exact Chat destination, where text entry and send remain product UI operations.
